option_relations.rationale: The option describes a superior vena cava syndrome caused by a benign lipomatous mass, which is consistent with a cardiac lipoma of the superior vena cava.
The option describes cardiac lipomatous hypertrophy with SVC involvement, which is consistent with a cardiac lipoma of the superior vena cava.
Lipomatous hypertrophy of the interatrial septum is a specific location of cardiac lipoma, which could be part of a broader cardiac lipoma involving the SVC.
The option describes an interatrial septal lipoma causing SVC compression, which is consistent with a cardiac lipoma of the superior vena cava.
